title: 3 Months In
author: Enjoyooooor
selftext:
I started this project a little over 3 months ago with a goal of creating a simple idle clicker with the help of LLM’s. I wanted to capture the aesthetic of early 2000’s rpgs like Ragnarok Online and Maplestory. 

After about a month in I was having so much fun with it that I decided to take on a bigger challenge, a full free to play idle rpg with deep incremental systems. I have no development background I am just an enjoyer of games.

I feel like I am about 10% of where I’d like to be but I’m very eager to build out the rest. I’ll leave the links for anyone interested in trying it out. Open to constructive criticism!

WIN,MAC,WEB
